description: The L2 plan names an endpoint suite and explicitly static migration contract tests, but it does not identify an executable PostgreSQL harness or database-role matrix. Mocked RPC arguments and static SQL inspection cannot establish real statement-snapshot membership under concurrent commits, the complete-or-overflow behavior at the fixed limit, RLS enforcement, or function/table denial for PUBLIC, anon, and authenticated roles. A real PostgreSQL migration/concurrency/access-control harness and its command/artifact are required.

evidence.snippet: panel-api-score-semantics.test.js ... exact RPC arguments/scope ... transaction-snapshot concurrency fixture ... panel-score-migration.test.js: static migration contract for checks, uniqueness, RLS, grants, and indexes.
